note: Initial thresholds and target ranges for the M3 music-information analysis and 2mix perceptual proxies (docs/SPEC.md 4.2 P-01/P-11/P-17/P-19/P-20, 6.3). All values are initial values subject to calibration (4.9); none is a standard. Penalty shape for every range: 0 inside [lo, hi], 1 - exp(-(d/scale)^2) for a distance d outside (core/analysis/perceptual.py range_penalty).

level_match.note: Every spectral comparison is done after normalising to this integrated loudness (R-01). Any value works as long as the reference uses the same one.

erb.note: ISO 226:2003 contour level used for the P-01 band weights (mix evaluation at a moderate-loud listening level). Lower phon values weight the low end down further (R-03).

p01_generic_prior.note: Broad fallback when no reference set exists (4.6 item 3): a pink-like power tilt with gentle band limits and a wide tolerance. It is NOT the Harman curve and not a genre target (R-17). The comparison is shape-only: the median band offset is removed before scoring. Reports must say the evaluation is against a generic guide, not a genre.

p11_harshness.note: Prominence = mean ERB-band level in 2-5 kHz minus the mean of the neighbouring bands' levels (linear interpolation in log frequency). A pink-like spectrum gives about 0 dB. The two-sided presence range serves OF-3 (deficit and excess). Fatigue link is weak evidence (8.1).

p17_sibilance.note: Frame ratio r(t) = level(5-8 kHz) - level(1-4 kHz) per ~21 ms frame. Events are active frames where r exceeds its median by event_threshold_db. Hi-hats and cymbals can also trigger it; stem context (vocal) refines it later.

p19_smoothness.note: Deviation of the 1/12-octave LTAS (dB) from its 1/3-octave smoothed version (mean of dB). penalty = max(rms deviation penalty, largest peak penalty). Transferred from loudspeaker preference research (spectral smoothness); the report must say so (4.2 note). Tonal music shows note peaks at semitone resolution, so the tolerance is generous.

p20_contrast.note: Section contrast is watched for preservation (R-26): shrink = contrast_before - contrast_after measured on the same section boundaries. No absolute contrast target.

sections.note: Short-term loudness segmentation. Minimum section length = max(min(4 s, length/3), min(length/30, 16 s)). Labels by position between the quietest and loudest section level; all 'mid' when the spread is below min_change_db.

music.note: Estimates carry a confidence in 0..1; decisions that depend on estimates below low_confidence_below are flagged in the Mix Report (6.3).
